title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Compressible NS source provides conservative state, Euler flux and Newtonian/Fourier terms; numerical validation remains limited by case results.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: solver.cpp:126–138 loads CGNS on root; partition.cpp:249 uses METIS and :284 distributes serialized local meshes.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: residual.cpp assembles face fluxes and viscous contributions; solver applies first-order positivity fallback. No independent order-of-accuracy verification.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:35–50 selects Rusanov subsonic and Roe supersonic; report acknowledges low-Mach dissipation and source implements Harten entropy treatment.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Report and source implement farfield, slip and no-slip; io.cpp:216–222 explicitly outputs zero no-slip velocity (also writes zero for slip).

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: reconstruction.cpp:214–220 caps gradients at default0.5 or production0.3, while residual.cpp:19–24 multiplies face gradients by the cap. It is nonzero but is not linearly exact under a fixed cap; formal second-order accuracy is unverified and the first-order M2 viscous case is disclosed.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth limiter is implemented but capped0.3–0.5 even in smooth regions; CFD2D_FIRSTORDER zeroes reconstruction for disclosed M2 viscous production.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier source exists; io.cpp:63–65 projects wall traction tangentially. Re20 Cd7.114 and laminar Cd2.287 show large numerical errors.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: implicit.cpp:89–107 builds scalar diagonal and BDF contribution; report documents low CFL caps and limited pressure-velocity coupling.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: Historical f262da0 time_integrate.cpp:133–145 and residual.cpp:131–145 implement BDF1 startup and BDF2; Re200 was honestly failed with no sustained shedding. Binary and individual inner ratios remain unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partition and neighbor-only halo implemented; global mesh exists only during root setup and is freed before iteration. Short reported rank comparisons do not establish scalability generally.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
